heading: Error codes
text:
## Error codes [IRET.21]

Rete-specific status codes, extending the libds
`ds_status_t` taxonomy ([IERR]):

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DS_ERR_RETP_INVALID` | An `AlphaNode` / `BetaNode` / `TerminalNode` atom carries `node_id` 0 or a `node_id` another already holds ([RDSC.11.1]). A body that fails decode is `DS_ERR_DSC_DECODE` ([RDSC.11.4]). |
| `DS_ERR_RETP_INDEX_OOB` | A node cross-reference (`node_id` — a beta parent / alpha / terminal parent) did not resolve to a loaded node (IRET.16.8). |
| `DS_ERR_FN_NOT_FOUND` | At load, a `CallExpr` carries a `BuiltinFn` op that is zero, out of range, or has no handler registered in `ds_builtin_dispatch[]` ([RDSC.4a.9.3], IRET.13.1). |
| `DS_ERR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED` | `ds_rete_run` exited because `max_fires > 0` was reached before the agenda drained (IRET.11.4). |
